ev.q: Each game in Spyro Reignited Trilogy is a 3D platformer
Multiple aspects of the game were praised, such as the upgraded visuals
the games feature a number of collectibles which must be acquired to make progress
while also chiding the game's inconsistent frame-rate and "slippery" controls
particularly the overall "bland" and linear objectives
non-playable characters exhibiting more unique and expressive personalities
